policy: Official Honda Automobiles U.S. specification pages only for vehicle facts. Missing/non-applicable values are explicitly resolved and never guessed.

HR-V.transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT); Real Time AWD with Intelligent Control System available
HR-V.efficiency: 2027 EPA ratings: 26/32/28 mpg city/highway/combined with 2WD and 25/30/27 mpg with AWD
HR-V.dimensions: 179.8 in L × 72.4 in W × 63.4-63.8 in H depending on trim; 104.5 in wheelbase
HR-V.cargo: 24.4 cu ft standard cargo volume; 55.1 cu ft maximum
HR-V.technology: Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, Bluetooth connectivity, USB-C ports and available Qi wireless phone charging
HR-V.safety: Honda Sensing safety and driver-assist technologies, including Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation, Lane Departure Warning and related assistance features

Prologue.engine: Battery-electric drivetrain with single-motor FWD or dual-motor AWD depending on configuration
Prologue.efficiency: EPA efficiency up to 113/94/104 MPGe city/highway/combined for FWD; AWD ratings include 108/90/99 MPGe on EX/Touring and 104/87/95 MPGe on Elite
Prologue.dimensions: 192.0 in L × 78.3 in W × 64.7-65.2 in H; 121.8 in wheelbase
Prologue.cargo: EX: 25.2 cu ft rear cargo with seats up and 57.7 cu ft seats down; Touring/Elite: 23.7 cu ft up and 54.5 cu ft down
Prologue.technology: 11.3-in color touchscreen, 11-in digital instrument cluster, Google built-in, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless phone charging and HondaLink connected by OnStar
Prologue.safety: Honda Sensing/driver-assistance suite includes automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist, adaptive cruise control, blind-zone and rear cross-traffic functions, with parking/surround-view features varying by trim

CR-V e:FCEV.engine: Proton Exchange Membrane fuel-cell system with AC synchronous permanent-magnet electric drive motor and 17.7-kWh lithium-ion plug-in battery
CR-V e:FCEV.transmission: Fixed single-speed direct-drive transmission with Sport Mode and Shift-by-Wire
CR-V e:FCEV.efficiency: 61/52/57 MPGe city/highway/combined on the listed EPA rating; 94/79/87 MPGe when hydrogen fuel and HV battery are combined in Honda's specification table
CR-V e:FCEV.dimensions: 187.6 in L × 73.5 in W × 66.6 in H; 106.3 in wheelbase; 6.7 in ground clearance
CR-V e:FCEV.cargo: 25.2 cu ft behind the second row; 29.7 cu ft standard / 61.0 cu ft max behind the first row
CR-V e:FCEV.technology: 10.2-in digital instrument cluster, Bose 12-speaker audio, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, USB-C charging and 120V/1,500W external power supply
CR-V e:FCEV.safety: Honda Sensing includes Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation, Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping Assist, Traffic Sign Recognition and Blind Spot Information

Civic Hatchback.engine: 2.0L inline-4; hybrid trims pair the 2.0L Atkinson-cycle engine with Honda's two-motor hybrid system
Civic Hatchback.horsepower: 150 hp Sport; 200 hp total system output on hybrid trims
Civic Hatchback.torque: 133 lb-ft on Sport; hybrid electric drive motor rated at 232 lb-ft
Civic Hatchback.transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission with paddle shifters on Sport; Direct Drive Unit on two-motor hybrid trims
Civic Hatchback.efficiency: 2026 EPA ratings: Sport 30/38/34 mpg and hybrid trims 50/45/48 mpg city/highway/combined
Civic Hatchback.dimensions: 179.0 in L × 70.9 in W × 55.7 in H; 107.7 in wheelbase
Civic Hatchback.cargo: 24.5 cu ft cargo volume with rear seat up
Civic Hatchback.technology: Wireless smartphone integration and connected infotainment features, with premium audio and Google built-in available by trim
Civic Hatchback.safety: Honda Sensing driver-assist suite; Blind Spot Information is available on applicable trims

Civic Si.transmission: 6-speed manual transmission with rev-match control and helical limited-slip differential
Civic Si.dimensions: 184.0 in L × 70.9 in W × 55.5 in H; 107.7 in wheelbase
Civic Si.technology: Bose 12-speaker premium audio, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility and performance-focused driver displays
Civic Si.safety: Honda Sensing driver-assistive features plus Blind Spot Information System

Civic Type R.transmission: 6-speed manual transmission with rev-match control and helical limited-slip differential
Civic Type R.dimensions: 180.9 in L × 74.4 in W × 55.4 in H; 107.7 in wheelbase; 4.8 in ground clearance
Civic Type R.cargo: 24.5 cu ft cargo volume with rear seat up
Civic Type R.technology: Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation, HondaLink, Bose 12-speaker premium audio, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto and performance telemetry/display features
Civic Type R.safety: Honda Sensing includes Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Collision Mitigation Braking, Road Departure Mitigation, Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control, Traffic Sign Recognition, Blind Spot Information and Cross Traffic Monitor

Prelude.engine: 2.0L Atkinson-cycle inline-4 with Honda two-motor hybrid system
Prelude.torque: Hybrid electric drive motor rated at 232 lb-ft; gasoline engine 134 lb-ft @ 4,500 rpm
Prelude.transmission: Direct Drive Unit with Honda S+ Shift
Prelude.dimensions: 178.4 in L × 74.0 in W × 53.4 in H; 102.6 in wheelbase
Prelude.technology: Google built-in, Bose premium audio, HondaLink and Honda S+ Shift performance interface
Prelude.safety: Honda Sensing safety and driver-assistive technologies

Ridgeline.transmission: 9-speed automatic transmission with Shift-By-Wire and paddle shifters; i-VTM4 AWD standard
Ridgeline.efficiency: 2026 EPA ratings: 18/24/21 mpg city/highway/combined on most trims and 18/23/20 mpg on TrailSport configurations
Ridgeline.dimensions: 210.2 in L × 78.6 in W × 70.8 in H; 125.2 in wheelbase; 64.0-in bed with tailgate up / 83.0 in down
Ridgeline.cargo: 33.9 cu ft truck-bed cargo volume plus 7.3 cu ft lockable In-Bed Trunk
Ridgeline.technology: Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, truck-bed utility features and connected infotainment equipment varying by trim
Ridgeline.safety: Honda Sensing includes Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control; Blind Spot Information and Cross Traffic Monitor are included in the current spec table

Odyssey.transmission: 10-speed automatic transmission with Shift-By-Wire and paddle shifters; front-wheel drive
Odyssey.dimensions: 205.2 in L × 78.5 in W × 69.6 in H; 118.1 in wheelbase
Odyssey.cargo: 32.8-38.6 cu ft behind the third row, 86.6-91.0 cu ft behind the second row and up to 155.8 cu ft behind the first row depending on measurement/configuration
Odyssey.technology: Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Magic Slide second-row seats, CabinTalk, CabinWatch and available 12.8-in rear entertainment system
Odyssey.safety: Honda Sensing includes Collision Mitigation Braking with advanced pedestrian detection, Road Departure Mitigation, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning and additional driver-assist features
